asset_role: visual-only whitewater breakup mask multiplied by solver-authored aeration; no hydraulic, collision, wet-mask, bathymetry, or raft-force authority
generation_method: project-directed generation of an orthographic sparse Zambezi whitewater lace and bubble-cluster mask
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable game texture; grayscale foam-lace mask for solver-masked Unreal water rendering. Primary request: create a square, seamless grayscale mask for sparse Zambezi River whitewater foam lace. Use a black-dominant field covering more than 70 percent of the image, with irregular branching lace, broken crest fragments, elongated downstream bubble clusters, turbulent holes, and intermittent high-volume river aeration patterns. Style/medium: production game data mask, not a beauty image; pure grayscale with white representing foam coverage and black representing no foam. Composition/framing: orthographic square texture, edge-to-edge, seamless/tileable with mirror addressing; distributed detail without a central focal point. Color palette: grayscale only, deep black dominant, sparse white and gray filaments. Constraints: crisp but organic multi-scale mask, useful under solver hydraulic masking; no text, no watermark, no logos, no banks, no rocks, no raft, no people, no colored water, no normal-map colors, no lighting or perspective. Avoid: broad opaque white sheets, uniform noise, repeated stripes, cellular honeycomb patterns, regular dots, obvious spirals, hard seams, photographs.

texture.encoding: RGB grayscale breakup mask sampled from the red channel

limitations: The asset is procedural visual infill rather than measured Zambezi foam imagery or rapid-specific calibration.
Mirrored GPU addressing is required because opposite source-image borders are not byte-identical.
The material must multiply this texture by solver-derived foam and speed channels so it cannot paint whitewater into calm or dry cells.
In-engine visual, guide, water-VFX, and target-hardware acceptance remain required.
